name: Lychee
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diets due to low FODMAP content and natural antimicrobial properties.
preparationTips: Remove the rough pink shell and white translucent flesh reveals easily
Remove the dark seed from center before eating
Choose fruits that give slightly to pressure but aren't mushy
Store ripe lychees in refrigerator for up to one week
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C (over 100% daily value per serving)
Good source of copper and potassium
Contains oligonol, a polyphenol with antioxidant properties
Low in calories (about 60 calories per 5 fruits)
